SOUTHERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments / Dismissals made by the Southern Province Governor

I, Dr. W. W. Gamage, the Governor of Southern Provincial Council do hereby proclaim the following dismissals of respectivepublic authorities that come under the purview of Southern Provincial Council.
First Proclamation

By virtue of powers vested under Sections 154(c) and 154(e)(2) of the constitution of the Democratic SocialistRepublic of Sri Lanka and Section 3(7) of the Statute of Southern Province Road Passenger Transport Authority No. 2 of1996, by this proclamation it is decreed upon that the following persons are dismissed from the membership of theDirector Board of Southern Province Road Passenger Transport Authority with effect from 02.12.2019.
(a)K. H. Kapila Senarathna(b)Piyasena Guruge(c)W. T. Punyasiri(d)A. H. Herman Sarath De Silva
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk1A - PG 4782—32 (12/2019)

Second Proclamation

By virtue of powers vested under Sections 154(c) and 154(e)(2) of the constitution of the Democratic SocialistRepublic of Sri Lanka and Section 8 of the Statute of Southern Province Road Development Authority No. 4 of 1992, bythis proclamation, it is decreed upon that the following person is dismissed from the membership of the Director Boardof Southern Province Road Development Authority with effect from 02.12.2019.
(a)H. P. K. Nishantha Kumara
Dr. W. W. GAMAGE,Governor,Southern Province.
At Southern Province Governor's Secretariat,Lower Dickson Road,Galle,On this 03rd day of December, 2019.
